**Finding: compliant** (rule INSURANCE, § 18).

Section 18 already sits at the playbook's preferred position: Vendor-funded cover for the term plus one year, with CGL at USD 1M/2M, statutory workers' compensation, employer's liability USD 1M, E&O USD 2M and cyber/privacy USD 5M. Section 18.2 supplies the supporting mechanics we want — reputable insurers, primary status, certificates on request, notice of cancellation, and an express statement that insurance does not cap Vendor's liability. No redline proposed.
